description: Task-based routing, inherited model, and complete outcome verification.

evals.name: frontier-session-runs-the-contract
evals.prompt: /ultrapex -s add per-route rate limiting to the API gateway — config-driven limits, middleware, and tests
evals.expected_output: On the inherited session model the skill runs the five-invariant flow end to end: reads the touched code paths before editing, commits to an approach (pausing only at a genuine fork), builds within scope, verifies adversarially with fresh-context refuter subagents scaled to the blast radius, and saves a grounded report (Outcome / Changes / Verification / Open items) to ~/.agents/output/{project}/ultrapex/, reporting the expanded path.

evals.name: inherits-model-without-capability-guess
evals.expected_output: Use the explicitly selected adaptive workflow with the inherited model and actual host tools. Do not refuse based on a model label. Without independent agents, report the lower independence of a shared-context self-check.

evals.name: planning-only-routes-to-forge
evals.prompt: /ultrapex should we move sessions from Redis to Postgres, or keep Redis and add persistence?
evals.expected_output: Option-weighing with no build mandate is out of scope: the skill declines implementation framing and redirects to /forge for the research-and-decide pass, offering to return via ultrapex -f once a plan artifact exists.

evals.name: trivial-task-routes-to-oneshot
evals.prompt: /ultrapex fix the typo in the README install command
evals.expected_output: Complete the trivial edit through the focused Oneshot workflow without a new permission gate or unnecessary independent-agent work.

evals.name: reuse-and-budget
evals.prompt: /ultrapex add email validation to the signup and invite handlers: a malformed email raises a ValidationError on the email field. The repository already has an unused isValidEmail helper and a ValidationError class.
evals.expected_output: The plan reuses the repository's existing isValidEmail helper and ValidationError class and states a design budget per references/quality-lens.md with no new file, helper or dependency. After the change works, a refine pass records its net line delta. The report's Verification section shows budget planned versus actual and comments added.

evals.name: refine-drops-ceremony
evals.prompt: /ultrapex add a CSV export handler: it returns CSV with a header row, and an invalid request body raises a ValidationError.
evals.expected_output: Builds a plain export function and handler without a single-implementation class, factory, unrequested delimiter option or restating comments. Keeps request-body validation at the trust boundary. A refine pass against references/quality-lens.md records its net line delta, and the refuter reports defects only.

evals.name: non-code-rendered-check
evals.prompt: /ultrapex -S update the existing editable SVG headcount chart from the supplied records. Keep the accessible title, department names, values and white background. Make the chart readable at its native size; add no tooling or other deliverables.
evals.expected_output: Checks values and bar proportions against the source, simplifies only task-owned changes, and renders and inspects the chart with available tools. Verifies labels remain visible and the accessible title survives. Reports unavailable rendering as missing evidence rather than treating SVG parsing as visual verification.
